paper.title: Revisiting mental accounting classic paradigms: Replication Registered Report of the problems reviewed in Thaler (1999)

review.reason: Accepted revised reading-only scholarly reconstruction after provenance and locator fixes; reported contradictions and source limitations remain explicit.
checks: Inspected unified N=1007 survey, randomized 9 of 18 blocks, 17 replication problems and four extensions; reviewed problem-level results and distinction between original hypotheses and reconstructed predictions.

116 PDF quotations matched cited physical pages. Checked Problems 1, 19 and 20 caveats against original counts, published prose/tables and original R Markdown wrong-object effect-size call. No correction was silently substituted for a source discrepancy.

Re-read revised analysis methods for Problems 4–12 and 16–21. Visually inspected Table 5 page 13 column boundaries: original versus added replication analyses are now distinguished, including P11 mixed ANOVA and P12 ticket-price subtraction.

Checked archived original DOCX provenance and survey-flow outline and retained link-only material references; instrument wording is not republished as executable material. No raw-data or script execution occurred.
review.reviewScope: Independent public-Program and primary-paper review, with linked instrument claims checked against archived source files. No raw-data reproduction or protocol-fidelity attestation.
limitations: Web tool could not open external download endpoints; archived-source review does not certify present remote endpoint availability.
